items.title: allofus.one Puts Members in Control of Their Social Network: Their Feed, Their Ads Setting and Their Data
items.summary: allofus.one, the free Denver-built social network, is built around member control: a chronological feed, an ads on-off setting and data you can take with you.
items.content_text: allofus.one, the free social network built in Denver, is inviting people to try a social platform designed around one idea: the member is in control. At [allofus.one](https://allofus.one/), members decide whose posts they see, whether they see sponsored posts at all, and what happens to their data. The platform has been in public beta since Oct. 11 and is free to join. Most large social networks decide what each person sees with a ranking algorithm, and the settings that change that are often hard to find. allofus.one starts from the other direction. Its feed shows posts from the people and groups a member chose, newest first, with nothing ranked or inserted by an algorithm. Sponsored posts are labeled, and members can switch them off in their ad settings. items.title: allofus.one Opens Its Free Social Platform in Beta: One Account for a Chronological Feed, 3D Worlds and VR in the Browser
items.summary: allofus.one opens its free beta: one account for a chronological feed, a 3D world in the browser and VR on Quest, plus free tools.
items.content_text: allofus.one, a free social platform built in Denver, is now open to the public in beta at [allofus.one](https://allofus.one). One account works three ways. There is a regular social feed. There is a 3D world that runs in a phone or laptop browser. And the same world opens in virtual reality on a Meta Quest headset through the headset’s web browser, with nothing to install. The feed is chronological. Posts from the people and groups a member chooses appear in the order they were made, with no ranking algorithm deciding what to show first. Members can download their data or delete their account from the Control panel at any time. Sponsored posts in the feed are labeled, and members can switch them off in their ad settings. ## One account, three ways in - **Feed.** Personal pages, connections, groups, reactions, comments, photo and video posts, polls and buy, sell and trade groups, at allofus.one. - **3D.** A browser-based world at allofus.one/world/ with avatars, homes members can claim and build, live rooms, games and places to explore. - **VR.** The same world in WebXR on a Quest 3 headset, with controller movement, teleport, a laser pointer and a wrist menu.
